bullets_zh: BrainFlow 为 OpenBCI、Galea、Cyton、Ganglion 等非侵入式 EEG 板提供统一的 Python/C++/C# API。
文档涵盖支持设备、流式/回放/合成设备、数据采集、滤波和示例。
适合构建无需植入硬件的消费级 BCI 应用。
bullets_en: BrainFlow provides a unified Python/C++/C# API for non-invasive EEG boards such as OpenBCI, Galea, Cyton, and Ganglion.
The documentation covers supported boards, streaming/playback/synthetic boards, data acquisition, filtering, and examples.
It is useful for building consumer BCI apps without invasive hardware.

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for EEG/BCI Development
bullets_zh: 开源SDK面向ADS1299 EEG采集，覆盖8–64通道硬件及MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包。
包含Verilog RTL以及PC、移动端和Linux集成，支持Python/MATLAB/R分析与BCI工作流。
2026年9月发布于GitHub，构成较完整的非侵入式EEG/BCI开发生态。
bullets_en: Open-source SDK targets ADS1299 EEG acquisition with 8–64 channel hardware and MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages.
Includes Verilog RTL plus PC, mobile and Linux integration for Python/MATLAB/R analysis and BCI workflows.
Published on GitHub in September 2026 as a broad non-invasive EEG/BCI development ecosystem.
items.brief: ADS1299 EEG采集SDK，提供多通道硬件、软件集成与BCI工作流参考。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK with multi-channel hardware, software integration and workflow references.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.
